_comment: REGISTRATION PAGE COPY (English). REAL CONTENT (2026): the registration model itself changed, not just the copy — taqa.org.sa's own live 'هاكثون الطاقة' page registers people by ROLE (Researcher / Entrepreneur / Judge), each with its own native form hosted on the Association's site, not by competition track and not via Google Forms. The three 'forms' entries and their openHref links below were read directly from that live page's markup (each 'سجل الآن' button's real href). deadlineNote's date is unchanged (already real, matches home.*.json's countdown, set in Phase 1). noteBodyPrefix no longer claims 'requires Google sign-in' — that was true of the old placeholder Google-Form pattern this page used to describe, not of these real native forms.
